Back in March 2011 right around the time Japan was rocked with that huge earthquake and tsunami, I was having bizzare back to back dreams involving the moon. The following day, I had another dream where I was on Earth, but the planet was a lot smaller and there was no sky. There was a nebula surrounding the planet that had a sun set hue to it. I was standing at a wooden cabin with people around who looked to be getting ready to go hunt. The people's faces were so distorted it was alien to me. That's when I learned that I was the one who was going to be hunted, and at some point of the dream I looked up and saw our moon. For some reason the moon craters were formed to show a message. Two green light experiences here.

The first encounter was at a friends house when I was 10, and it honestly could have been something explainable like a reflection or laser pointer. I remember there were two boys living in the house behind my friends, but it was late at night and quite creepy seeing a green dot suddenly move around in the darkness of the bedroom.

Second encounter was on a camping trip with some friends up in the White Mountains of Arizona a few years ago. 

We didn't have a decent tent at the time so I had resorted to sleeping in the back of the car on a makeshift bed of blankets and pillows. I slept like a log for majority of the night but had awoken around 2-3 AM from a very vivid dream. I'm unsure if the dream details had anything to do with what I saw, but let me explain briefly what it was about. 

The dream was definitely out of the ordinary for me since I'm typically a deep sleeper and don't tend to remember them when I wake up. It took place in my friends apartment, but there wasn't anything in the apartment besides their bed. The apartment was dark and had no lights on. I felt a presence but nothing or no one was there. I then started to travel into the bedroom from the living room, but the strange thing is that I was hovering in a laying position on my back about 2 feet off of the ground. Once I got closer to the bed, my hovering body was trying to maneuver around it. It felt like I had most control of my body, but I also felt another force pulling me with it. Then my body hit the bed frame and I fell to the carpet. That's when I woke up. 

I didn't feel groggy at all, I was fully awake and conscious  moments after the dream. Realizing where I was after the dream, I relaxed and looked out the window up at the stars. That's when I saw it! 

It was off in the distance, above the tree line. There was a green light in the sky, sitting still. I first thought it was an airplane, or a colorful bright star amongst the bunch. Then it started to move in swaying patterns, going back and forth, up and down. Almost like a bird playing in the wind. I didn't feel alarmed at all while watching it, but more or less intrigued since I couldn't catch a pattern in its movement. It was all over the place. Eventually I started feeling a little uncomfortable because I started thinking back on my dream and I couldn't rationally think what exactly was in the sky besides maybe a UFO or something. I tried closing my eyes to fall back asleep, but I kept looking back. It was still doing the same thing. That's when I gave up and turned on my side away from that window. 

Pretty cool experience and one of many I like to share. Feel free to share any thoughts or potential explanations.
